AUTH_FORGOT_SENT: If that email exists, a reset email has been sent.
AUTH_RESET_SUCCESS: Password reset, please sign in with the new password
AUTH_RESET_MISSING_TOKEN: This link is invalid or expired, please request a new one.
HOME_DEV_PLACEHOLDER_TITLE: The homepage is provided by a theme
HOME_DEV_PLACEHOLDER_DESC: In production `/` is rendered by the active theme (D94). This is the built-in SPA's dev placeholder: the Vite dev server bypasses Go's theme dispatch, so visiting `/` lands here. Theme management lives under Administration → Themes.
FORBIDDEN_DESC: Your account does not have access to this page. Contact an administrator if you believe this is a mistake.
NOT_FOUND_DESC: There is no page at this address; the link may be broken.
PLACEHOLDER_TODO_DESC: The frontend base (W7) is done: design system, UI kit, HTTP/SSE clients, routing and guards, sign-in and forced password change. Feature pages follow in later workflows.
SETTINGS_W8_NOTE: Password change, API tokens and GitHub binding arrive in W8.
SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session expired, please sign in again
